defs.def: to get away from a place where you have been kept as a prisoner or not allowed to leave （从监禁或管制中）逃跑，逃走，逃出
to get away from an unpleasant or dangerous situation （从不愉快或危险处境中）逃脱，摆脱，逃避

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。

ex.s: (You can see how that works in the video above.) The strips of red, white, and black shells all come from Langa Langa Lagoon, where artificial islands were long-ago built by locals to escape from the island-dwelling cannibals.
ex.t: （你可以在上面的视频中看到它是如何运作的。）红、白、黑相间的贝壳条都来自兰加兰加泻湖，当地人很久以前就在那里建造人工岛以躲避岛上的食人族。

defs.def: to avoid sth unpleasant or dangerous 避开，避免（不愉快或危险的事物）

ex.s: This is something that even the highly successful Harry Potter movies can’t escape from, with fans of the books disappointed not to see some of their favourite characters in the movie versions.
ex.t: 这甚至是极为成功的《哈利\u00b7波特》电影也无法逃脱的，书迷们因为在电影中没有看到一些他们最喜欢的角色而感到失望。

defs.def: to suffer no harm or less harm than you would expect （没有受伤或只受了一点伤害而）逃脱，幸免于难

ex.s: When World War I broke out, Priestley joined the army, and escaped death on a number of occasions.
ex.t: 第一次世界大战爆发时，普里斯特利参军了，并数次死里逃生。

defs.def: to be forgotten or not noticed 被忘掉；被忽视；未被注意
to get out of a container, especially through a hole or crack 气体、液体等

ex.s: When a volcano erupts, volcanic ash and even rocks escape through a large opening at the top.
ex.t: 当火山喷发时，火山灰甚至岩石都会从顶部一个巨大的开口中喷涌而出。

defs.def: to come out from your mouth without you intending it to 声音
the act or a method of escaping from a place or an unpleasant or dangerous situation 逃跑；逃脱；逃避

ex.s: A lunchtime escape allows her to keep a boss from tapping her on the shoulder.
ex.t: 午间逃离让她得以避免老板拍她肩膀。

ex.s: Second, the Engines would be set at full power to accelerate the Earth into “escape velocity”, thus propelling it away from the Sun.
ex.t: 其次，发动机将被调到全功率，使地球加速到“逃逸速度”，从而推动它离开太阳。

ex.s: These five stages were also known as the “Reining Age”, the “Escape Age”, the “First Wandering Age” (during acceleration), the “Second Wandering Age” (during deceleration), and the “New Sun Age”.
ex.t: 这五个阶段也被称为“刹车时代”、“逃逸时代”、“第一流浪时代”（加速期间）、“第二流浪时代”（减速期间）和“新太阳时代”。

defs.def: a way of forgetting sth unpleasant or difficult for a short time 逃避现实；解脱；消遣

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意开得稍远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次很棒的周末出游。

defs.def: the fact of a liquid, gas, etc. coming out of a pipe or container by accident; the amount that comes out 漏出，溢出，渗出（量）
a button on a computer keyboard that you press to stop a particular operation or leave a program * Esc 键；退出键
